integrity: The endpoint and cap-body criteria are taken from inspected literature; the subcritical formula is supported by the explicit analytic construction and lower bound. Finite checker output is treated only as a replay aid, not as proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the common-radius six-axis family in dimension three and to ordinary illumination; it does not classify arbitrary cap bodies, unequal radii, or multiple illumination.
title: Endpoint instability of the six-spike octahedral cap body
